# **Build brief**

**RE Compass v1: a map of where renewable energy projects meet sensitive areas**   
Prepared by WeSolve Foundation for BetterGov.ph   
15 September 2026

## 

## **Why this brief**

FES Philippines and Forum for the Future (through the Responsible Energy Initiative) asked WeSolve to build the first working version of a Philippine renewable energy transition map. A mock-up exists from December 2025\. This brief asks BetterGov to build the version that will be shown to partners at a Forum-hosted workshop on 4 November 2026, where the whole consortium will give feedback. The brief makes the scoping decisions so BetterGov can start building, not interpreting.

## 

## **Policy question the map answers:**

***Where do existing and planned renewable energy projects overlap with protected areas, ancestral domains, and municipal fishing waters?***

A community should be able to find out whether a project is planned near them. A mayor should see whether a project clashes with a boundary. A developer should see the same before committing money. All three get the same overlay; only what they do with it differs.

## 

## **What v2 is**

A public, browser-based map with four layers, a search, and a plant detail panel.

| Layer | What it shows | Source | Status | Link to data (reference pages) |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| RE power plants (existing and committed) | Point per facility: name, owner, technology, capacity, province, stage, target year | DOE power plants dataset | In hand |   |
| Award DOE RE Projects as of April 2025 |  |  | April 2025 awarded RE infra projects up to the level of Barangay Has down to barangay level DOE awarded service contracts  |  |
| Land Conflict |  | Land Watch Asia | To be uploaded |  |
| Land Conflict |  | Land Matrix | Available online |  |
| Protected areas | Polygons of NIPAS and other protected areas | DENR-BMB, NAMRIA | Public, to be pulled \- needs API   |  |
| Ancestral domains | CADT and CALT boundaries | NCIP | Public not downloadable from geoportal needs OCR, to be pulled; check coverage gaps |  |
| Municipal waters | 15 km municipal water boundaries | NAMRIA / BFARUP-MSI (Doc Mike)  | Public, to be pulledCan share potentially shape file |  |

**Core functions:**

1. Toggle layers on and off.  
2. Search by plant name, province, or municipality.  
3. Click a plant to open a detail panel with its fields and a flag if it sits inside or within 5 km of any sensitive layer.  
4. Filter plants by technology, stage, and island group.  
5. A simple "overlaps" list: plants that touch any sensitive layer, downloadable as CSV.

Design reference: the BetterGov transparency dashboard. Same visual language, same idea that the data is open and downloadable.

## 

## **What v1 is not**

* Risk scores or ratings for lenders  
* Community-submitted or crowd-drawn maps  
* Permit and licence conflict checks  
* Jobs, wages, gender, or mining data (the FES data matrix)  
* Case narratives such as the ALPAS solar housing story  
* Any login or user accounts
